scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && exec node --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
scripts.test: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT && COOP_DATA_DIR="$tmpdir" tsx --test src/*.test.ts
scripts.healthcheck:published: COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL="${COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL:?Defina COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL com a URL publicada}" tsx src/coop-healthcheck.ts
scripts.healthcheck:monitor: COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL="${COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL:?Defina COOP_HEALTHCHECK_URL com a URL publicada}" COOP_HEALTHCHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS="${COOP_HEALTHCHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-300}" tsx src/coop-healthcheck.ts
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test && pnpm run healthcheck && if git diff --quiet -- src/data/coop-progress.json src/data/coop-rooms.json; then :; else echo 'Os snapshots de coop versionados foram alterados pela suíte:' >&2; git diff -- src/data/coop-progress.json src/data/coop-rooms.json >&2; exit 1; fi
